title: State of Maryland Payments Data
use: All payments by state agencies to businesses, local governments, non-profits and individuals, by agency and payee, per fiscal year (portal description)
portal_name: State of Maryland Payments Data: FY2008 to FY2024
mismatch_notes: Row count and yearly totals match the portal. The portal title says FY2008 to FY2024, but the data runs to FY2027 (FY2027 is partial). Each row is a yearly total per agency and payee; the date field is January 1 of the year, so timing rules cannot run. FY2022 lists a second block of $874.5M for MDTA and Maryland Environmental Service, confirmed on opendata.maryland.gov and vendorpayments.maryland.gov; reported as a source issue, never a lead. The portal refreshed this dataset on Nov 9, 2026 at 16:00 UTC, 16 minutes after that day's extract, adding 1,649 FY2027 rows; re-extracted Nov 10, 2026 and matched again. Mapping, FY2026: 100.0% of dollars map to a budget agency; 38.6% of dollars are in the default payee type 'Business or other' and non-profits are 0.2%, likely under-identified (see the payee classifier's review queue); 1,040 of 62,022 payee names carry a focus area, by design only the six GMI areas.
